faq.title: Quick answers to common client doubts
faq.q1: Do you only work in Venice?
faq.a1: No, we cover all of Northern Italy. In addition to Veneto, we actively and promptly serve clients in Lombardy, Emilia-Romagna, and Friuli-Venezia Giulia.
faq.q2: Do you handle both industrial and civil sectors?
faq.a2: Yes, we cover both sectors. Our teams specialize in both the design and implementation of complex HVAC systems for industries, as well as residential and commercial solutions.
faq.q3: What are the average installation times?
faq.a3: It depends on the complexity of the system. Generally, standard residential systems take 1-2 working days, while industrial projects are planned in detail during the quotation phase.
